```{r}
#| label: setup
#| results: false
source("setup.R")
fits <- get_fits()
```

# PSIS-LOO

```{r}
#| label: loo
#| results: false
for (m in specs$model) {
  fits[[m]] <- add_criterion(fits[[m]], criterion = "loo", moment_match = TRUE)
  if (any(fits[[m]]$criteria$loo$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7)) {
    fits[[m]] <- add_criterion(fits[[m]], criterion = "loo", moment_match = TRUE,
                               reloo = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pareto-k
#| tbl-cap: "Number of observations with Pareto k > 0.5."
tibble(
  model = specs$model,
  pareto_k_over_0.7 = sapply(specs$model, function(m) sum(fits[[m]]$criteria$loo$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7))
) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-loo-compare
#| tbl-cap: "PSIS-LOO comparison of all models."
loo_compare(setNames(lapply(specs$model, function(m) fits[[m]]$criteria$loo), specs$model)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(any_of(c("model", "elpd_diff", "se_diff", "elpd_loo", "se_elpd_loo", "p_loo"))) |>
  kable(digits = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-loo-r2
#| tbl-cap: "LOO-R2 (log scale)."
bind_rows(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  as.data.frame(loo_R2(fits[[m]])) |> mutate(model = m, .before = 1)
})) |>
  kable(digits = 2, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Leave-states-out (optional)

```{r}
#| label: kfold-state
#| eval: false
state_folds <- loo::kfold_split_grouped(K = 10, x = cigar$state)
kf <- setNames(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  kfold(fits[[m]], folds = state_folds, seed = SEED,
        allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian")
}), specs$model)
loo_compare(kf)
```
